name: Sarian
source:
Porny's biological older sister. She loves jewels. Along with her younger sister, she runs the village inn left to them by their father, Gilly. She lives with Colin and Bonnie. Gilly died when Colin and Bonnie were young, so Sarian has been supporting them all as their older sister. The story begins when she sends Colin on a cave exploration.
